full_details: Mistress Ansell counted four candle-ends and called the clear board repentance. You tied the comedy's foul sheets and put them on the shelf, with Brooke on the left. You paid her fivepence for a quire she had by her, and twopence for a new horn of her ink. Field's paper stayed at his shop. You counted the coffer and did not say the figure, and you did not rule a new column. The Lent list was written and nothing on it was struck. You walked to Finsbury and back, and later walked there again, and the second time you did not try any name aloud. The board at the end of the day was the cleared one. Before eight the shoes were off. Monday's baskets are in the book, and they are not on the list.
one_sentence: You cleared the board, paid fivepence for a quire and twopence for ink, walked to Finsbury, and had your shoes off before eight.
title: Cleared the board and wrote the Lent list
